hed: Beta Com: A Shining Beacon in the constellation Coma Bsc.
dek: An overview of Beta Com, its celestial significance, and its role in our understanding of the night sky.
body:
Beta Comae Berenices, designated as Beta Com, is a notable star situated within the constellation Coma Berenices. This star, cataloged under the Bayer designation, serves as an accessible and intriguing point of interest for both amateur astronomers and scholars alike. Located approximately right ascension 13.19 hours and declination +27.88 degrees, Beta Com is comfortably positioned for observations from various latitudes, offering a splendid view of the celestial sphere.

As a stellar object, Beta Com contributes to the broader tapestry of our galaxy, showcasing the characteristics typical of its stellar class. Although specific parameters such as its exact distance, apparent magnitude, and spectral type are not specified here, it is recognized as a figure star within the celestial map, linking it to traditional asterisms and star charts. Its placement near other notable celestial features makes it a valuable reference point in the region of Coma Berenices.

The star's role extends beyond mere positioning; it helps define the boundaries and shape of the constellation itself, acting as a fundamental anchor in the lore and observational astronomy associated with this part of the sky. Stars like Beta Com exemplify the richness of the celestial sphere, illustrating both the beauty and complexity of the universe.

In the context of celestial navigation and star mapping, Beta Com continues to serve as a reliable marker, aiding stargazers in orienting themselves within the night sky. Its inclusion in various star catalogs and its position within accepted macrobert constellation figures underscores its significance in both historical and modern star lore. Observing Beta Com can deepen appreciation for the structure of our galaxy and enhance skills in celestial navigation.

While the detailed astrophysical properties of Beta Com remain to be narrowly outlined here, its consistent identification across multiple star catalogs affirms its status as a fixed point amid the ever-moving canvas of the cosmos. For whoever looks up on a clear night, Beta Com stands as a resilient symbol of our ongoing curiosity about the universe. Its steady glow invites us to continue exploring, understanding, and marveling at the vast universe beyond our world.
